title: Mr G Hughes v Asda Stores: 1802226/2015
text:
EMPLOYMENT TRIBUNALS

Claimant: 			 Mr G Hughes

Respondent: 		 Asda Stores Asda Stores

Heard at:					Leeds					On:		11 & 12 February 2016

Before:					Employment Judge Burton
Members:				Ms N H Downey
							Mr J Howarth

Representation
Claimant:				Mr K Ali, of Counsel
Respondent:			Mr J McMorrow, Solicitor


JUDGMENT

1.	The complaint of Race Discrimination is dismissed upon withdrawal.

2.	The complaint of Unfair Dismissal succeeds.

3.	Upon terms of settlement having been achieved the remedy hearing is adjourned generally pending the completion of a COT3 agreement with liberty to either party to apply to reinstate the hearing within 28 days of the date that this Judgment is sent out to the parties.


					_____________________________

					Employment Judge Burton
					
					Date__________________________

					JUDGMENT SENT TO THE PARTIES ON

					 .....................................................................................

					 ......................................................................................
					FOR THE TRIBUNAL OFFICE


Note
Reasons for the judgment having been given orally at the hearing, written reasons will not be provided unless a request was made by either party at the hearing or a written request is presented by either party within 14 days of the sending of this written record of the decision.
description: Employment Tribunal decision of Judge Burton on 11 and 12 February 2016.
